title.en: Attentive veterinarians and dedicated nursing staff

text.en: Most clients express strong satisfaction with Dr Sharp and the veterinary assistants, regularly noting their helpfulness and warmth. Long-standing patrons appreciate the gentle handling provided to pets throughout wellness examinations and diagnostic appointments. Although a couple of clients reported isolated administrative friction, the team is widely commended for clinical competence.

title.en: Gentle handling for anxious companion animals

text.en: Pet parents frequently note how carefully and gently their cats and dogs are treated during clinic visits. Reviewers with nervous or ailing pets appreciate that staff take time to soothe animals, ensuring examinations proceed without undue stress. Owners value the compassionate atmosphere, noting their animals feel welcomed and secure.

title.en: Informative guidance alongside occasional communication gaps

text.en: Numerous pet owners appreciate staff answering telephone inquiries thoroughly and providing clear discharge instructions after routine appointments. However, several reviews highlight communication challenges, specifically regarding unexpected procedure costs, delays in laboratory results, and difficulty speaking directly with veterinarians.

q.en: Does the clinic offer pet dental cleanings and surgeries?

a.en: Yes, practice records and client reviews confirm routine dental cleanings, extractions, and general veterinary surgeries are performed.

q.en: Are walk-in appointments accommodated at the hospital?

a.en: The clinic operates primarily on scheduled appointments, and reviewers advise booking in advance as walk-in availability is limited.

q.en: Does the hospital provide pet grooming services?

a.en: Yes, Animal Hospital of Westover Hills offers professional pet grooming alongside medical care.

q.en: How do clients describe the consultation pricing?

a.en: Routine checkups are seen as reasonable, though clients recommend confirming estimates prior to extensive dental or surgical procedures.
